finding: Across all 21 aligned year-and-parameter tests, the WDI PM2.5 proxy shares at most one of its top three economies with the Lancet Countdown heat-related potential work-hours-loss measure.
non_claim: The dossier does not interpret modelled potential work-hours loss as observed absence, does not combine PM2.5 and heat into a new index, and does not rank policy performance.
